LanguageData.WeaponrankiconsDesc: Show veteran rank icons on energy weapons when zoomed in.
LanguageData.ShowresearchbuttonDesc: Add a Rimatomics research button to the main tabs. If disabled, you can still open it from the research bench tab.
LanguageData.MannedreactorconsoleDesc: Require a pawn to man reactor consoles to open the control window. If disabled, the window can be opened via a button.
LanguageData.AutothrotIDCount: Multiple cores set to {0}, each core must have a unique ID for auto-throttle to engage
LanguageData.AutothrotRange: Power net excess must be within 5000 W of the auto-throttle band ({0} to {1}) to engage.
LanguageData.AutothrotTip: Engage auto-throttle.\n\nAutomatically adjusts flux to keep the excess between {0} and {1} on every power net this reactor feeds through its transformers.
LanguageData.AutothrotLost: Auto-throttle disengaged for {0}: the console lost its reactor or the reactor stopped.
LanguageData.AutothrotStatus: Auto-throttle: {0}.\nExcess {1} on {2} power net(s), holding {3} to {4}.
LanguageData.AutothrotState_Settling: waiting for the reactor to settle
LanguageData.AutothrotState_WarmingUp: waiting for the core to warm up
LanguageData.AutothrotCharging: Charging batteries ({0} full), holding above the band until they are full.
LanguageData.AutothrotBandTip: Auto-throttle band: {0} to {1} excess.\n\nAuto-throttle keeps the power net excess inside this band. A higher band leaves spare power to charge batteries. Click to change.
LanguageData.CoreIdMismatch: Reactor and console IDs do not match. Each reactor needs its own console with a unique ID for auto-throttle.
LanguageData.MissingPESUpgrades: If Preemptive Strike is active, its Sky Object Detection research must be completed before ATOM can detect incoming drop pods. Scramblers will still operate normally.
LanguageData.ShortRangeStratLaunchDesc: Launch a tactical missile strike on this map.
LanguageData.LongRangeStratLaunchDesc: Launch a strategic missile strike anywhere on this planet.
LanguageData.HighYieldWarheadDesc: Launches high-yield warheads that cause a catastrophic blast over a huge area. Expect widespread destruction—only deep mountain bunkers are likely to offer meaningful protection.
LanguageData.LowYieldWarheadDesc: Launches low-yield warheads for a smaller, tactical blast with reduced collateral damage.
LanguageData.RimatomicsValveLabelDesc: Toggle the valve open or closed
LanguageData.FlareScramDesc: SCRAM the reactor during solar flares
LanguageData.Rimatomics.LowCoolingCapacityDesc: A reactor cooling building is running at low capacity\n\nTowers need to be unroofed, water coolers need enough surface water, if you are using bad hygiene link mode make sure cooling towers are filled with water
LanguageData.AlertNeedsTurbineDesc: A reactor needs to be connected to a turbine, failure to do so may result in overheating and meltdown
LanguageData.AlertNeedsCoolingDesc: A turbine needs to be connected to a cooling system, failure to do so may result in overheating and meltdown
LanguageData.AlertCoreMeltDesc: A reactor is suffering a core melt incident, evacuate immediately
LanguageData.AlertCoreOverheatDesc: A reactor is being damaged due to overheating
LanguageData.AlertCrackedDesc: Stress from running the core at high temperatures for a long period of time has caused the core to crack, it will need to be deconstructed and rebuilt or it will continue to emit lethal radiation, produce less power and damage the fuel rods.
LanguageData.PodsScrambledOK: Enemy drop pods scrambled by TACS
LanguageData.PodsScrambledDesc: Enemy drop pod guidance systems were scrambled by TACS using a {0} kW pulse.
LanguageData.PodsScrambledFail: Failed to scramble enemy drop pods
LanguageData.PodsScrambledFailDesc: The {0} kW pulse required to scramble this raid was not available.
LanguageData.ScrambleDropPodsDesc: Prevent raiders from landing near the center of the map by using a large energy pulse from connected PPCs to scramble incoming drop pod guidance systems.
LanguageData.TemperatureTip: Temperature\n\nHigh temperatures can damage the core and crack fuel rods. If the core reaches 0 HP at or above normal operating temperature, it will explode.
LanguageData.FuelTip:
Fuel

Total fuel loaded in the core. Adjacent fuel rods chain-react, producing more power.
Fuel output decreases over time until the rod is spent.
LanguageData.CoolingTip: Cooling\n\nCooling capacity currently in use. If the gauge turns red, add cooling or reduce power output.
LanguageData.TurbineTip:
Turbine

Turbine capacity currently in use. If the gauge turns red, add turbines or reduce power output.

Turbines also require transformers to distribute power to standard power nets.
LanguageData.PowerTip: Power\n\nRaw reactor output. This does not include how much power is actually delivered through turbines and transformers.
LanguageData.RadiationTip: Radiation\n\nA damaged core emits radiation. Radiation output increases as core integrity decreases.
LanguageData.Dragtoincreasefluxlevel: Drag to increase flux level to produce more power
LanguageData.cycleScreensDesc: Monitor all reactors on this network
LanguageData.AutoScramDesc: SCRAM the reactor core when the temperature reaches unsafe levels, or a solar flare is detected
LanguageData.FlareSCRAMletterText: A solar flare has triggered a reactor SCRAM
LanguageData.SCRAMletterText: Unsafe core temperature has triggered a reactor SCRAM
LanguageData.ATOMdetectionDesc: The TACS has detected a possible threat, it is estimated that {0} will attack {1} in approximately {2}
LanguageData.ICBMNeedConsole: Requires a manned SACS weapon console
LanguageData.ICBMNeedMissile: A missile is required for launch
LanguageData.criticbmAttack: The enemy faction {0} is preparing to launch a missile attack from a nearby base. You have {1} days before launch.
LanguageData.critBombDetFac: The bomb detonated and the {0} has been destroyed
LanguageData.MessageRailgunNeedsMap: Map not generated. Send colonists to scout the area first.
LanguageData.TestFireHELSOnOwnShells: Shoot down our own mortar shells for data gathering.
LanguageData.BreederHotLoadingDesc: Allow fuel to be changed while the core is running
LanguageData.critscramDesc: Return temperature and neutron flux to base values. The core remains powered.
LanguageData.critStartupDesc: Starts the core, allowing temperatures and flux levels to rise
LanguageData.critShutdownDesc: Shut down the core. It remains powered but cool, allowing refueling and repairs.
LanguageData.NoActiveBenchWithProject: No active bench with the required project.
LanguageData.critPlaceOnCore: Must be placed on a molten core of correct type
LanguageData.NeedsRiver: Needs to be placed next to a river, lake or ocean
LanguageData.critMoreWater: Requires a larger body of water
LanguageData.critSpentOnly: Set for spent fuel only, none available
LanguageData.critCoreIntegrityDesc: The integrity of this core is so low that it may crack.
LanguageData.TradeShipPriceNeed: Need {0} silver to send trade ship
LanguageData.TradeShipReq: A Rimatomics trade ship has been dispatched to your planet.\n\nIt will take 2 days to arrive.
LanguageData.PowerLimitDesc: Change the power limit for this transformer, used for changing power distribution over multiple power nets\n\nHold Shift for finer control
LanguageData.BlueprintUpgradeDesc: This is a blueprint upgrade, new constructions will have this upgrade built in as standard, existing buildings will need to be manually upgraded using the crafted module
LanguageData.ResearchPriceNeed: Requires {0} Silver near a trade beacon
LanguageData.coreUpgradeFail: Can't upgrade while core is active
LanguageData.powerUpgradeFail: Building must be powered down before upgrading
